title: A Morning Walk Through the Park
text:
Every morning, Anna walks through the big park near her flat. The park has a lake, tall trees and a small café. Many people come there to run, read or feed the ducks. Anna likes the park because it is quiet before work.

Last month, the park got new benches and a long path for bicycles. The city also planted two hundred young trees. The magazine asked Anna what she thought of the changes. She said the park now feels more beautiful, and she visits it even more often.

questions.text: What does the park have near the lake?
What did the city plant in the park?
Why does Anna enjoy walking in the park early in the morning?
options: It is calm and quiet before work
It is the only place with a café
It is the cheapest park in the city
It is open only in the morning

questions.text: What can the reader infer about Anna's opinion of the changes?
options: She is pleased with the new park
She wants the old benches back
She thinks the trees are too young
She does not visit the park anymore

vocabulary.definition: long seats for more than one person, often outdoors

paragraph_translations: Każdego ranka Anna spaceruje przez duży park w pobliżu swojego mieszkania. Park ma jezioro, wysokie drzewa i małą kawiarnię. Wiele osób przychodzi tam, żeby biegać, czytać lub karmić kaczki. Anna lubi ten park, ponieważ przed pracą jest w nim cicho.

W zeszłym miesiącu park dostał nowe ławki i długą ścieżkę dla rowerów. Miasto posadziło też dwieście młodych drzew. Magazyn zapytał Annę, co myśli o zmianach. Powiedziała, że park wygląda teraz piękniej i że odwiedza go jeszcze częściej.
